t: You are at the site of St Mildred, Bread Street, which stood on the east side of Bread Street. The church was dedicated to Saint Mildred, a seventh-century saint and the daughter of a West Mercian sub-king. It was of medieval origin, and the Great Fire of 1666 destroyed it. Sir Christopher Wren then designed the church that replaced it. It was one of the few City churches to keep Wren's original fittings into the twentieth century. Bombs destroyed it in 1941.
